test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All surveys are research.

Some surveys are books.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some research are surveys.

II. All books are research.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and II follow.
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given Statements:

All surveys are research.

Some surveys are books.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/842d71ba47305311724e2b4a805b63af953b249097a4c4162223b4fe0445b707.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some research are surveys. - **True** (because All surveys are research given. So, Some research are surveys it is definite)

II. All books are research. - **False** (because Some surveys are books and All surveys are research. So, it is possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only Conclusion I follows".**
